Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Modern Magnolia Print, White Frame, 40" x 40"
Colors: Multicolor
A modern refresh of a classic floral, this print features highly detailed petals of a white magnolia against a dark background. The stark contrast and texture is accented by a white frame, for a piece that adds a natural element to any style room. 40"W x 40"H Printed on paper in white frame A modern take on a classic nature subject that will fit with any décor Ready to hang, all hardware included
